instructions: Use separate agent sessions when a user asks for a subagent, independent review, or parallel help. When the workflows plugin supplies delegation tools, invoke delegate for one task or delegate_many for independent tasks; do not merely describe delegation. Consult the available model profile catalog. Children are read-only by default. /agents is an operator command opening the agent session switcher; /parent returns to the parent. A selected child can be stopped with double Escape without cancelling siblings.
